scenes.audio: Aisha receives a premium payment...
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: Static wide view. Beige background. Dark teal header at top. Circular gold logo at bottom left. Minimalist corporate lighting, flat color palette.

scenes.audio: ...while the agency is short on cash.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A white rectangular box appears on the left with a teal arrow pointing right. Static camera, flat lighting, high-key beige and white tones.

scenes.audio: That money is not a convenient loan for rent.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A second dark teal box appears in the center. Graphic layout remains static with uniform soft lighting.

scenes.audio: A producer handles money belonging to others with fiduciary responsibilities. Misappropriating, converting, or unlawfully withholding money...
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A third white box appears on the right. Completed row of three boxes with teal arrows. Static graphics, consistent beige background.

scenes.audio: ...can support license discipline. Keep an accurate record of receipt: the client, the insurer, the purpose, and the amount.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Graphic remains static. Three labeled boxes horizontally aligned. Logo in bottom left corner. Muted corporate color scheme.

scenes.audio: The fact that a commission will eventually be earned does not make the entire premium the agency’s income. Follow the process from the start.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Static display of information graphic. Soft, even lighting across digital surface. Dominant beige and teal tones.

scenes.audio: Maryland's premium account regulation defines prompt remittance...
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: New header slide. Single white box on left. Static framing, minimalist graphic design, soft digital illumination.

scenes.audio: ...as sending premium money to the carrier or insured...
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Second light teal box appears in center. Layout maintains symmetry and flat perspective.

scenes.audio: ...no later than the close of the fifth business day following receipt. A producer who does not make prompt remittance must maintain the premium...
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Third white box appears on right. Full layout of three boxes. Static camera, flat corporate aesthetics.

scenes.audio: ...in one or more premium accounts, separate from operating and personal accounts. Do not count business days as calendar days.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Static graphic with informative text. Teal and white boxes on beige. Even lighting, low saturation palette.

scenes.audio: A premium account is restricted money, not an everyday spending account.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Static informative slide. Central focus on box layout. Clean, professional digital background.

scenes.audio: A documented process should show where the money is...
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Third header slide. One white box on left. Static composition, gold logo remains in dark circle bottom left.

scenes.audio: ...and who is entitled to it.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Second dark teal box appears in center. Minimalist transitions, high key lighting, teal accents.

scenes.audio: Not every mixture of funds is the same. Maryland permits voluntary deposits into a premium account and generally allows multiple carriers' premiums...
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Third white box appears on right. Static graphic showing three informative categories. Soft lighting, neutral background.

scenes.audio: ...unless prohibited by a carrier or a special rule. It prohibits mixing the premium account with an operating or personal account.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Informational slide remains static. Text layout with three white and teal boxes. Professional, flat corporate style.

scenes.audio: Withdrawals are limited to authorized purposes. A withdrawal cannot leave less than the required aggregate net premiums. Reconcile the account.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Static information screen. Three-box layout. Consistent beige backdrop with teal header and gold logo.

scenes.audio: Compensation for selling, soliciting or negotiating insurance...
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Fourth header slide. Single white box on left. Static digital frame, minimalist design, soft lighting.

scenes.audio: ...generally goes to a licensed producer...
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Second light teal box appears in center. Layout maintains static perspective on beige background.

scenes.audio: ...subject to statutory exceptions. Paying through a different label does not cure unlicensed selling. Maryland also permits certain renewal...
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Third white box appears on right. Static view of three categories. Even lighting, corporate teal and beige palette.

scenes.audio: ...or deferred commissions to a person who formerly held the required license. Other permitted payments must still avoid unlawful rebating.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Informative slide remains static. Labeled boxes with descriptions. Flat, professional digital aesthetic.

scenes.audio: Identify what the person actually did and their required authority.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Static final state of the compensation slide. High-key lighting, soft shadows, teal header text.

scenes.audio: A producer cannot simply add any charge the customer will tolerate.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Fifth header slide. Single white box on left. Static composition, minimalist corporate layout.

scenes.audio: Maryland restricts collecting premiums or charges different...
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Second light teal box appears in center. Soft lighting, uniform beige environment.

scenes.audio: ...from those applicable to the insurance. One exception permits a placement service fee of no more than fifteen percent of the premium...
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Third white box appears on right. Static layout with three detailed boxes. Teal arrows present.

scenes.audio: ...when the insurer does not pay commissions. For a thousand dollar premium, that ceiling is one hundred fifty dollars.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Static informative slide regarding fees. Clean graphic lines, professional color grading, soft lighting.

scenes.audio: Verify the applicable exception, disclose accurately, and keep a record.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Static view of fee authority slide. Beige and white tones dominate. Minimalist aesthetic.

scenes.audio: Record retention depends on the document and rule.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Sixth header slide. Single white box on left. Static framing, corporate minimalist design.

scenes.audio: Maryland appointment records are kept while active...
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Second light teal box appears in center. High-key lighting, consistent corporate style.

scenes.audio: ...and at least five years afterward. Under the annuity recommendation rule, covered transaction records are maintained for seven years.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Third white box appears on right. Final graphic layout with three information boxes. Static camera.

scenes.audio: An insurer may keep those records for a producer, but the producer should verify that arrangement rather than assume it exists.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Static record retention graphic. Labeled categories on beige background. Gold logo visible bottom left.

scenes.audio: Preserve readable, retrievable documents and signatures. Good records connect the advice, disclosure, payment, and final transaction...
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Informational layout remains static. Text-heavy white and teal boxes. Soft digital illumination.

scenes.audio: ...so another reviewer can understand what actually happened.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Static final shot of the presentation. Beige background with teal header and gold circle logo. Minimalist flat design.
